changes.name: Gallery
changes.before: Aureform Gallery. Native vectors and component instances; source media uses prepared original assets, with manual controls.
changes.after: Aureform Gallery. Native editable controls and captions with generated editorial IMAGE fills from the source collection; six 3:2 thumbnails and a 3:2 full-image preview. Callers without dimensions retain the source default ratio.

changes.name: Carousel
changes.before: Aureform Carousel. Native vectors and component instances; source media uses prepared original assets, with manual controls.
changes.after: Aureform Carousel. Native editable manual controls and captions with generated editorial IMAGE fills; native specimens retain the controlled 16:10 crop. Source collection images are 1200 by 800.

changes.name: VideoPlayer
changes.before: Aureform VideoPlayer. Native vectors and component instances; source media uses prepared original assets, with manual controls.
changes.after: Aureform VideoPlayer. Native editable playback controls with a generated Quiet forms IMAGE fill for the paused poster. The original vector motion specimen and unavailable fallback are preserved.
